articles.summary: ISSAQUAH, Wash., Oct. 07, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Costco Wholesale Corporation (“Costco” or the “Company”) (Nasdaq: COST) today reported net sales of $30.02 billion for the retail month of September, the five weeks ended October 4, 2026, an increase of 13.0 percent from $26.58 billion last year. Comparable sales were as follows: 5 Weeks U.S. 12.5% Canada 6.3% Other International 10.8% Total Company 11.4% Comparable sales excluding the impacts from changes in gasoline prices and foreign exchange were as follows: 5 Weeks U.S. 8.0% Canada 4.9% Other International 7.7% Total Company 7.6% Digitally-enabled sales, which are sales initiated through a digital device, whether fulfilled through a warehouse, distribution center, or Costco Travel, increased year-over-year as follows: 5 Weeks Reported 19.0% Excluding Foreign Exchange 19.1% Labor Day in the U.S. and Canada occurred one week later this year. articles.title: Costco Wholesale Corporation Reports September Sales Results
